actions.title: REDACTED: a HIGH severity finding in the release-pipeline-per-project-ps1-stack lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Extract the three-step illustration resolution into one exported resolveIllustration(state, ctx) that render.js and illustration-picker.js both call.
Drive the live botanical and icon preview from the same ranked result the dropdown shows, or gate the live autofill on an exact or alias match only.
Cache the parchmentBg output keyed on the texture and the theme gradient fields so it regenerates only when one of them changes.
Have the nightly sweep stamp a one-line heartbeat every night whether or not drift-auto-fix runs, so a missing drift-fixes report reads as a quiet night rather than a silent failure.
Build a short qualifier into printCardHtml whenever a compounds or cautions zone is present, so it ships inside #print-stage rather than the app footer the print sweep hides.
Drive the editor's Content-section inputs from tmpl.fields, or correct PROJECT_SPEC.md 4.7 and CLAUDE.md to say the per-field editor markup is hand-authored.
Add a node test that mocks localStorage to throw and asserts loadState, saveState and clearState each call notifyStorageError with the right operation, and add it to scripts/preflight.ps1.
Gate the print-stage rebuild and its fitPrintStage reflow behind a dirty flag so it runs before a print or export rather than on every keystroke.
Add a source field per herb record, or soften the compounds and cautions language to folklore framing until the citation pass lands.
Assert in a test, or in a shared constants module, that export-png.js's LAYOUT_RULES match the @media print block in styles/label.css for every layout class.
Extend the contrast gate in test-data-integrity.mjs to check every theme's latinColor, shopColor and descColor against that theme's paperGradEnd, not only herb accents.
Give the announcements post its own dedupe state so a failed announcements post can be retried without forcing a duplicate dev-log post.

Add a check that compares the commit which last touched the pill against HEAD and fails when unbumped commits sit above it, since check-version-pill.ps1 only compares the three locations to each other.
Run scripts/release.ps1 to ship the four pending commits and refresh the published mirror, which still serves the pre-split editor.js from v1.1.14.
Wrap each of the five mounter calls in src/ui/editor.js in its own try/catch that renders a local fallback, so one panel's failure does not blank the whole app.
Give createState's notify() catch the same document-event escape hatch persist.js uses, so a panel frozen by a render error is visible on screen rather than only in the console.
Wrap release.ps1's three-location pill stamp in one try/catch that reverts index.html when a later write fails, or cache the intended version instead of re-deriving it from index.html.
Wire patchNested and updateLabel into real call sites or delete them, and correct the CLAUDE.md:77 claim either way.
Add file-layout rows in CLAUDE.md for src/util/truncate.js, src/util/suggest.js and src/util/escape-html.js, matching the format the other utility files already get.
Change src/main.js:354 to color:var(--warn) so the fatal-error screen tracks the design token the v1.1.12 changelog says it already uses.
Run the YesAndEverything release so update-project-pages.mjs re-stamps the Apothecary card and pages, which still read v1.1.11 beside the app's own v1.1.14 footer.
Route push-to-github.ps1's merge-conflict scan through Invoke-Git instead of the raw git call with a stderr redirect inside a swallowing try/catch.
